We are also given that after throwing away the old ones, Danny had 33 bottle caps in his collection.

First, we simplify the equation: x + 63 - 51 = 33. 
This simplifies to x + 12 = 33. 
Next, we subtract 12 from both sides of the equation: x + 12 - 12 = 33 - 12. 
This simplifies to x = 21. 
Therefore, Danny had 21 bottle caps at first.
